cases.question: How does Pay in 4 work?
cases.answer: Pay in 4 splits your purchase into four equal, interest-free payments. The first payment (25% of the order total) is charged at checkout, and the remaining three are charged automatically every 2 weeks, so the plan is paid off in 6 weeks. You can see every due date in the Lumio app under Purchases, and we'll send a reminder 3 days before each payment.

cases.question: What's the difference between Pay in 4 and Pay in 30?
cases.answer: Pay in 4 splits your purchase into four equal, interest-free payments: 25% at checkout, then the rest every 2 weeks, so it's fully paid in 6 weeks. Orders range from $35 to $1,500. Pay in 30 lets you receive your order first and pay the full amount up to 30 days after it ships, with no interest and no fee if you pay on time. Nothing is charged at checkout, and orders range from $10 to $600 at participating merchants.

cases.question: Can I get more time to pay it?
cases.answer: Yes, for a Pay in 30 purchase you can extend the due date one time, by 10 days, for a flat $3 extension fee. You must request it in the Lumio app before the original due date, because an overdue purchase cannot be extended. For Pay in 4, you can move the due date of one installment per order by up to 7 days for free, using "Change due date" in the app before that installment is due. If you're unsure which plan you have or need help with a specific purchase, a human agent can help.

cases.question: Will that hurt my credit?
cases.answer: Missed Pay in 4 payments are not reported to credit bureaus, so a late Pay in 4 payment won't affect your credit report. Monthly Financing payments are different: those that are more than 60 days late are reported to credit bureaus, and any balance unpaid for 90 days may be referred to a collections agency. A human agent can help with questions about your specific account.
